label: Setup · 1 of 2: It can wake you
note: First run. Grouped by what each check protects, in order; one Allow each. Replaces the 9-row Readiness list.

label: Setup · 2 of 2: It can follow the bus
note: Samsung's sleeping-apps step becomes a checked step with a button, not a paragraph.

label: Now · Ready (morning)
note: Idle Now. The likely route (time of day, then place, then last used) is one big Start. Home and Trip are one place.

label: Now · Not ready
note: A required check broke after setup: Now leads with it, in words, with one fix.

label: Now · Waiting for the bus
note: Started at the stop. The status line says the truth: a backup alarm until boarding is seen.

label: Now · Riding (armed)
note: Riding. Where, how far, how long, armed. The map is a peek on the same screen.

label: Now · Riding at night
note: The same screen at night: dim ground, the one action in wake amber.

label: Now · GPS lost
note: GPS lost changes the whole screen's tone and says when the backup rings.

label: Ringing · phone locked
note: The only loud screen. Night palette in both themes; the hold target fills the lower half.

label: Ringing · while using the phone
note: Over another app the ring is a heads-up with I'm awake; vibration starts at full strength.

label: Awake · what now
note: After I'm awake: what to do now comes first, the briefing below it.

label: Awake · early safety ring
note: An early ring says plainly that it's early and that it will ring again.

label: Now · Transfer
note: A clear 'you're off' moment, then the next stop, with the route as a rail.

label: Routes
note: Routes are buses in order. What's missing is said on the route itself.

label: Route · From work
note: One primary action: the next thing the route needs.

label: Set a stop · on the map
note: Pins are dropped on the map (or from your location, or a pasted link); the circle is set on the same map.

label: Settings
note: Preferences only. 'Report a missed alarm' replaces Debug → Share; Debug is hidden.

label: Lock screen · dozing
note: Where the rider actually looks while dozing: the Live Update and the optional timing question.
